text.p: Bulgarian World Cup goalkeeper Borislav Mihailov has left Reading by mutual consent, the English first division side said on Thursday.
Mihailov, 34, made only 28 appearances for Reading in his 18 months at the club and has flown back to Sofia six months before his contract was due to end.
He was troubled by injuries throughout his time at Elm Park and his latest, a damaged cruciate knee ligament suffered against Bolton last month, had ruled him out for the rest of the season.
Reading's joint-boss Mick Gooding said on Reading Clubcall: "There was no doubt he was a quality keeper, it was just unfortunate he was injured for most of the time he was here."
Mihailov, who has played 96 times for his country, told Clubcall: "I am sad things did not work out better."
